notes.title: Our new game "HRO" will be featured in Steam Next Fest!
notes.content:
Greetings, High Society!

We at W&M are [i]over the moon[/i] to share with you that we've announced our next title, and it will be available to play next week in Steam's Next Fest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26148231/e9792844166e63851e410b24c0c29acda8baa5fe.png[/img]

[b]HRO: Adventures of a Humanoid Resources Officer[/b] is a puzzle-driven visual novel set in a retro-futuristic sci-fi universe. You play the underappreciated Humanoid Resources Officer aboard the Endeavor — a military spaceship with more than its fair share of crew rivalries, office politics, and erratic decision-makers. When the Endeavor stumbles into universe-shaking trouble, you must harness the power of the bureaucracy to rein in your crew’s worst impulses and survive to the next episode! 

You can check out the game on the store page here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1198520/HRO_Adventures_of_a_Humanoid_Resources_Officer/

During Next Fest (June 16th - 22nd) you'll be able to download a free preview demo of HRO! Additionally, we've launched a W&M Discord server: https://discord.gg/4yWcQTn6gH
Please stop by and say hello! We'd love to connect and get your feedback on HRO!

notes.title: Austen Translation Musical Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30691731/e3c58a4fe8885af9ae44adcfd776720ba1da1e1f.png[/img]

Gentle People,

We hope you're all doing well out there and staying safe. 

We are delighted to announce that Austen Translation has received a musical upgrade. You may note that the dulcet tones of the rather frenetic accompanist sound a little different. Functionally, the music remains the same. But the previously utilized MIDI system has been replaced with a sampled piano. Keep an eye and an ear out for an update soon for a soundtrack release date. It's been a long-time coming but we're super busy here at W&M. 

Until the next announcement, enjoy this musical upgrade and as always, thanks so much for playing!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30691731/f46a82b68c8aa5ebd5f549925ba3485f18f1dac7.png[/img]

notes.title: Play "Austen" Online Now
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30691731/0b95ecb08003e7e0b947492b7540f3f1cbd2295c.jpg[/img]

With the release of Steam’s new “Remote Play Together” feature, you can now play “Austen Translation” with friends even when you’re not all in the same room — or even the same time zone. Better still, only one of you needs to have a copy of the game to enjoy a match with up to four human players. So get out there and test your strategic social maneuvering skills against your nearest and dearest!

notes.title: The Free Austen Expansion is Live
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/c230fac3921382dfc7c6eba4b2378839b637f0b6.png[/img]

Ladies and Gentlemen, 
We are delighted to annoucne that the Free November Expansion for [i]Austen Translation[/i] is live! For any players that already have [i]Austen Translation[/i], the new content will be downloaded as a regular update. Some of the new content includes:

• Four new social events featuring: The Hedgehog Races, the Temperence Lecture, a Grand Ball and the Amateur Theatricals.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/93679cc4dfb886d948fe1bb32e51c4c8a93f33fe.png[/img]
• Four new bachelors including: the dashing Commander Wrentham, the dapper Charles Muskrat, the athletic Reginald DeCorset, and the punctual John Lessland.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/1ce2ae398ddd05bea20488bc8e93c050168fa7ba.png[/img]
• New accessories for heroine customization -- Whether it's a hat or a hairbow, each hairstyle has its own unique adornment.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/80f05316ca7e4a781843b8e087e26be8ab7f1399.png[/img]
• Four new desktop wallpapers which will be listed in the store soon as free DLC. 
• As well as additional bug fixes and various improvements.

So after you've had some left-over turkey, gather up your friends and relatives and see which of you has the wit, ruthlessness and charm to survive  this regency non-dating sim!

Enjoy, everyone!

notes.title: Jane Austen Video Game Mocks A Society Obsessed With Marriage
notes.content:
Kotaku - May 11, 2018 (Gita Jackson)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/ff575967f007f230842798e3121f29b7c458df31.png[/img]

In the opening to the 1813 novel Pride and Prejudice, Jane Austen wrote, “It is a truth universally acknowledged, that a single man in possession of a good fortune, must be in want of a wife.” In the new 2018 video game Austen Translation, you play as a woman who’ll do anything to win over that kind of single man. It’s hilarious. [url=https://kotaku.com/jane-austen-video-game-mocks-a-society-obsessed-with-ma-1825964304] (more...)[/url]

Charming Ladies and Eligible Bachelors, 

After a little more than a year and a half of designing, writing and developing, 
[i]Austen Translation[/i] is finally out on Steam! Our small indie team is so grateful for all the support throughout the project, and especially to those of you that have kept tabs on our work through the dev blog.

This is only the beginning of our satirical romp through our world of Jane Austen. And certainly computational complications and bugs are not foreign to us, so if you encounter any unexpected unpleasantness please let us know here on Steam or feel free to contact us at: support@worthingandmoncrieff.com

Thank you so much! We sincerely hope that you enjoy Austen Translation, and that you don't die from a life of poverty and prostitution. Now get out there and show Jane exactly how it's done!

-W&M

notes.title: Strategy and Music in Austen Translation
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/9af2c389e38c386c0af0cb7628cde79c89a17371.png[/img]

[h1]“Without music, life would be a blank to me.”[/h1]
                                                     -Jane Austen

Gentlemen and ladies,
Our composer and sound designer was recently interviewed by Kate Remington of WSHU Public Radio for her video game music podcast [i]Music Respawn[/i]. The interview offers a glimpse into the inspirations and design of the game, and how the music can help give the players a strategic advantage during play. Tune in on your platform of choice for a sneak-preview of the musical soundtrack of [i]Austen Translation[/i].

You can listen here on [url=https://itunes.apple.com/us/podcast/music-respawn-with-kate-remington/id1148686069?mt=2] Apple Podcasts[/url].

Or you can also tune in on [url=https://play.google.com/music/listen?u=0#/ps/Ifozvp4c3frhntoxh76jtztjom4] Google Play Music[/url].

notes.title: A Behind the Scenes Look at the Development of Austen Translation
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30691731/e21ff57a219c0b32aa3aa62ac39c60be3e26116e.png[/img]

Ladies and Gentlemen,

We at W&M are not able to adequately explain in words how very excited our little team is about [i] Austen Translation[/i]'s release tomorrow. We have been hard at work crafting this, our second literary-inspired experience over the past year and half and we hope you enjoy it. If you're interested in getting a glimpse of how [i] Austen [/i] has developed over time, check out our development blog. You can get there from our website: http://austentranslation.com/

Thanks so much -- we can't wait for you all to play. 
And remember: Marrying well is the best revenge!

-W&M
